# SafeTrack Pro Global - AI-Powered Safety Management Platform

> Complete HSE software platform for risk assessment, incident reporting, PTW, compliance management, and AI-powered safety solutions across all industries.

---

## 🏢 About SafeTrack Pro Global

SafeTrack Pro Global is a comprehensive industrial safety management platform that helps organizations maintain compliance, reduce risks, and protect workers across multiple industries. Our AI-powered solutions serve healthcare, oil & gas, construction, manufacturing, aviation, maritime, mining, chemical, and industrial sectors.

**Website:** https://safetrackproglobal.com  
**Email:** info@safetrackproglobal.com  
**Phone:** +974 33251705

## 🎯 Core Features

### 1. Compliance Management
Automated tracking and reporting for all safety regulations across industries. Stay compliant with OSHA, ISO 45001, and industry-specific standards.

### 2. AI Risk Assessment
Predictive analytics and machine learning algorithms for proactive risk management and incident prevention. Achieve 94% AI accuracy.

### 3. Real-time Dashboard
Monitor safety metrics, incidents, and compliance status with customizable dashboards for any industry.

### 4. Smart Document Management
Create, manage, and share safety documents, SOPs, and templates with intelligent version control.

### 5. Advanced Analytics
Gain actionable insights from safety data with predictive analytics, trend analysis, and custom reporting.

### 6. AI Camera Monitoring
Real-time video analysis with PPE compliance detection, hazard identification, and behavior analysis.

### 7. Permit to Work (PTW)
Create, approve, and manage work permits and authorizations with complete audit trails.

### 8. Incident Reporting
Real-time incident reporting, investigation, and corrective action tracking across all industries.

### 9. Environmental Monitoring
Monitor air quality, emissions, waste management, and environmental compliance with ESG reporting.

### 10. Mobile-First Platform
Access safety data and report incidents from anywhere with responsive mobile interface.

## 🏭 Industries We Serve

| Industry | Key Solutions |
|----------|---------------|
| **Healthcare** | Patient safety, infection control, medical device compliance, staff safety |
| **Oil & Gas** | Process safety, HAZOP studies, permit-to-work, emergency response |
| **Construction** | Site safety, fall protection, equipment inspections, contractor management |
| **Manufacturing** | Machine safety, ergonomics, chemical handling, industrial hygiene |
| **Maritime** | Vessel safety, crew management, navigation safety, ISM compliance |
| **Aviation** | Flight safety, ground operations, maintenance tracking, regulatory compliance |
| **Mining** | Geotechnical safety, ventilation monitoring, equipment tracking, emergency response |
| **Chemical** | HazMat management, spill prevention, process safety, environmental compliance |
